items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: I didn't play, I played with, uh, Johnson Serenade, this down in Fres Adfield.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Let me think. We've got the list George Orveston band, uh, did you play in any other bands regular after that? Uh-huh.
